# Moodle Student Test Coverage Report

**Ground Truth:** `MoodleStudent.md` (136 test cases across 10 modules)
**Generated Tests:** `gpt-4o-mini/zero_shot_per_module/test-cases.md` (67 test cases across 10 modules)
**Generated by:** openai/gpt-4o-mini | **Approach:** Zero-Shot Per Module | **Report Date:** 2026-06-06

---

## Coverage Definition

> **Missing coverage** = An entire scenario or behaviour that is completely absent from the generated tests but is present in the ground truth.
>
> **Partial negative coverage is acceptable** — if the ground truth tests multiple individual-field empty/invalid cases and the generated tests cover at least one representative field of the same type, that counts as covered.
>
> **Extra** = scenarios present in the generated tests but not in the ground truth.

### Generated Tests Strengths
- Without few-shot prompting, GPT-4o-mini generates standard "happy path" positive tests flawlessly, understanding the generic architecture of a Learning Management System (LMS) natively.

### Weaknesses (Hallucinations & Domain Blindness)
- **Severe Mode Collapse:** Only 67 tests were generated in total. The model rigidly generates ~6-7 tests per module, refusing to exhaustively document Moodle's deeper features without few-shot examples forcing it to expand its volume limits.
- **File System Blindness:** The model completely missed testing file uploads across the entire application (Profile Pictures, Assignment replacements).
- **Role Blindness:** It failed to generate boundaries testing Student vs Teacher roles (preventing students from editing roles, managing enrollment, editing other students' profiles).
